scope: Finite generated ordinary and selected-CMYK print output; exact-code evidence bindings and actual positive/negative controls. Native interpreter and reader comparisons retain their recorded conditions.

rules.summary: Readable complete PDF with supported version, objects and cross references.
Integers and real values stay inside the supported architectural range.
Physical lines outside stream payloads contain no more than 255 bytes.
Names use valid UTF-8 and at most 127 decoded bytes.
Two direct, nonempty file identifier strings are present.
Encryption and permissions dictionaries are absent.
External streams, OPI, referenced Forms and file specifications are absent.
Only plain and Flate streams occur in this generated subset.
Actions, JavaScript and additional action dictionaries are absent.
Annotations are absent from the supported output.
Optional content and presentation variants are absent.
Interactive forms and rich-media/XFA content are absent.
PostScript XObjects and functions are absent.
Halftones, transfer functions and black-generation adjustments are absent.
Alternate image dictionaries are absent.
Page boxes are positive, correctly nested and contain exactly one trim/art box.
One embedded CMYK print condition has a meaningful identifier and description.
Embedded profiles are parseable printer profiles with matching size/channels/version.
Print content uses only the declared device model and gray.
Transparency groups, blend modes, masks and opacity use the supported definitions.
Graphics state uses supported rendering intents and overprint values.
Executed saved graphics states never exceed 28 and are balanced.
All content operators have known signatures and legal operands.
Every content resource reference resolves in the active resource dictionary.
Content strings contain no more than 32767 bytes.
Every font has a parseable embedded program and the supported composite encoding.
All emitted glyph widths agree with independently decoded program metrics.
Embedded program structures, bounds, checksums and reachable compact-outline instructions are consistent.
Font descriptors have required metrics and bounds for their embedded glyph outlines.
Embedded TrueType instructions execute at the declared independent interpreter settings.
Text references existing nonzero glyphs with embedded outlines and a Unicode mapping.
Decoded image and mask samples have the declared dimensions and supported components.
Shadings have valid geometry and bounded continuous/stitching component functions.
All metadata packets are unfiltered, well-formed supported RDF/XML packets.
Required title, dates, producer, creator, identifiers and trapping state are present.
Present Info fields agree with their mapped metadata values.
Print identity has the selected value and ordinary output makes no print claim.
